The provided onboarding document does not contain specific instructions for deleting or removing a model from the model list.

**Best guess based on the configuration design:**
* Models and providers are defined in your configuration file (typically located at `~/.hermes/config.yaml`). You can edit this file to remove unusable model definitions, endpoints, or fallback entries.
* Alternatively, you can run `hermes setup` in your terminal to reconfigure your providers and default models, or switch models during a session using the `/model <name>` command.
